enchantments.tooltip: Insightful Intelligence +6: This item focuses the power of the wearer's mind, granting a +6 Insight bonus to Intelligence.
Combat Mastery +11: +11 Enhancement bonus to the DC to resist the character's Trip, Improved Trip, Sunder, Improved Sunder, Stunning Blow, and Stunning Fist attempts.
Quality Resistance +2: Passive: +2 Quality bonus to Fortitude, Reflex, and Will Saving Throws.
Protection +11: Passive: +11 Deflection bonus to Armor Class.
Mythic Wrist Boost +1 or +3: +1 or +3 Mythic bonus to Physical and Magical Resistance Ratings.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
